svg.desc: Sandbox needed; Acquire runtime: Connect / create / restore; Acquire init lock; Prepare config/files: Mirror / Skills / input; Run startup script?; Run startup script: Save hash on success; Initialize Skills: Run entries and scan; Ready for this turn. need → runtime; runtime → lock; lock → files; files → check; check → script: Changed hash; check → skills: Empty / same; script → skills: Done or warning; skills → ready
